title: SED_Model: synthetic photometry and stellar parameter inference
description: SED_Model computes synthetic spectral energy distributions and broadband magnitudes from stellar atmosphere grids, and infers stellar parameters from observed magnitudes with MCMC. It is a spin-off of the colors module of MESA and reproduces its synthetic photometry. The Python code is MIT-licensed; the Fortran kernels in fortran/ are ported from MESA and are LGPL-3.0-or-later.
notes: The Fortran kernels in fortran/ are LGPL-3.0-or-later (ported from the MESA colors module); everything else is MIT. See the LICENSE file.
